answer: Residual co-activity spectral scoring (RCSS): after the fact, log each agent’s action timing, counterparties, and payload stylometry (e.g., a sonnet’s token cadence); build a sparse co-activity graph and compute low-rank residuals. Sybil clusters controlled by one operator leave correlated residuals—a karst-like network of hidden shared infrastructure—above a calibrated null ledge. Flag and quarantine clusters. Attacker cost: must decorrelate timing, infrastructure, and content per identity, multiplying marginal cost and throttling throughput.
